title: Set-valued pointed étale stalks and their germs on algebraic spaces
statement: Work in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $P$ be an $S$-scheme and $x:h_P\to X$. Use the category $N_X(x)$ of pointed etale scheme neighbourhoods and its chart projection from [def-sfb-space-pointed-etale-abelian-stalk]. For a sheaf of sets $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], define the pointed set stalk $F_x=\operatorname{colim}_{N_X(x)^{op}}F(U)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] in the containing universe. On a sheaf morphism take the induced map of colimits, giving a functor from sheaves of sets to sets. For each pointed chart $(U,p)$ the germ $F(U)\to F_x$ is its colimit cocone map. When $P=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ with $\Omega$ an algebraically closed field, these are the geometric set stalk and its germ maps.
